name: Trip Importer
author: raduwolf12
description: Reconstruct past trips from Polarsteps, GPS photos, booking PDFs/ICS, expense CSVs and Google Timeline — auto-creates the trip, journal, places, bookings and costs, with multi-trip detection and undo.

settings.label: TREK public base URL
settings.hint: Only needed for the photo-search feature (lets your imported photos show up in TREK's native photo picker, including for journal entries). Enter the URL you personally access this TREK instance at, under your own Settings — used to turn this plugin's own uploaded-file paths into absolute links. Leave blank to disable photo search for yourself; nothing else in this plugin depends on it.

settings.label: Immich server URL
settings.hint: Your self-hosted Immich server address. Your TREK admin must also allow outbound access to this host under Admin → Plugins (this plugin declares operator-managed egress since everyone's Immich server is different) — ask them to add it if the Immich picker can't connect. If the server is on a local network or Tailscale, TREK must also be started with TREK_PLUGIN_ALLOW_PRIVATE_EGRESS=on. Leave blank to disable importing photos from Immich.

settings.label: Immich API key
settings.hint: Create one in Immich under Account Settings → API Keys. Stored encrypted and only ever read by this plugin's server-side code — never sent to your browser.

settings.label: TREK public base URL (instance default)
settings.hint: Optional org-wide fallback for the "TREK public base URL" setting above. Used only for users who haven't set their own value under Settings → Plugins. Useful when every user on this instance accesses TREK at the same URL.

settings.label: Immich server URL (instance default)
settings.hint: Optional org-wide fallback for "Immich server URL" above, for instances where everyone shares one Immich server. A user's own value, if set, always takes priority. The admin must still allow outbound access to this host under Admin → Plugins.

settings.label: Immich API key (instance default)
settings.hint: Optional org-wide fallback API key, paired with "Immich server URL (instance default)" above, for a shared Immich server. A user's own key, if set, always takes priority.
